BiblicalUsage: The dashing of surf, the pounding of waves, as the psalm pictures the floods lifting up their pounding against the throne that is established from of old.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the waves may pound, but the throne stands, because the Lord is mightier than the noise of many waters.
